Best Brake Flaring Tools

A brake flare is not a bend. The tube end has to be folded back on itself in two passes, and a single flare cracks under the 1,000 to 2,000 psi a brake system holds. From a $39 clamp kit that covers 3/16 to 1/2 inch to a $175 hydraulic set that removes the lever and the clamp walk, here is what actually makes a flare that seals.

OTC 4503 Double Flaring Tool Kit

★★★★ (4.3) 781 reviews

The kit the forums point to. It covers every line size a normal car has, from the 3/16 inch brake line up to 1/2 inch, and it makes the two-stage fold that a brake flare needs. Cheap enough to keep on the shelf for the one job in five years that needs it.
